warmup: one complete untimed prediction per pipeline before timed rounds
timed_work: saved pipeline prediction on prepared inputs, including transformation, batching and probabilities
excluded_work: loading, warmup, verification, capture, flow completion and history construction
order: independently shuffled condition order each round with one seeded generator
interpretation: descriptive warm-process local wall times; no fitting, energy or live detection latency measurement

full_training_recipe.class_weighting: balanced training-observation weights once per learned classifier; dummy unweighted
full_training_recipe.selection_metric: mean of three validation macro F1 scores, fixed five-class label order
full_training_recipe.tie_break: first candidate in declared order within tolerance of the maximum
full_training_recipe.lr_retry_rule: retry only warning fits; stop on unresolved convergence
full_training_recipe.validation_interpretation: selection evidence, not an independent estimate of the entire tuning procedure
full_training_recipe.prediction_timing: estimator predict_proba on already encoded inputs; excludes preprocessing and packet/history extraction
full_training_recipe.transform_timing: one shared transformation per model/scope; repeated table value must not be summed across candidates

selection_recipe.denominator: active original fields in this training scope; round counts upward
selection_recipe.shap_sampling: without replacement within each true class; all available when below cap
selection_recipe.shap_perturbation: interventional with independent encoded components and explicit background
selection_recipe.shap_field_aggregation: signed component sum, then absolute value; mean across output classes, then within true class, then equal true-class mean
selection_recipe.shap_group_interpretation: aggregated component attributions, not jointly masked coalition-group SHAP
selection_recipe.shap_common_rank: equal model mean of average-tie ranks; exact doubled integer sums; alphabetical final ties
selection_recipe.tree_precision_correction: https://github.com/shap/shap/pull/5122; preserve float64 thresholds in SHAP 0.53.0
selection_recipe.mi_field_representation: fitted logical components; nominal categories coded jointly after training-only pooling; numeric values use saved medians; count/byte/missingness components discrete
selection_recipe.mi_distribution: capped stratified training sample; residual class imbalance retained; no duplicated rare rows
selection_recipe.performance_interpretation: paired observed differences; no formal equivalence claim or unapproved loss margin
selection_recipe.additional_conditions: no PI selector, classifier-specific reduced SHAP fits, or frequency-versus-balanced SHAP experiment
selection_recipe.mi_field_aggregation: maximum component MI within each active original field; not joint multivariate MI
selection_recipe.mi_width_limitation: maximum avoids sum/mean width scaling but wider fields have more opportunities for a high component score
selection_recipe.mi_sampling_interpretation: same capped training populations as declared; not the class-balanced SHAP estimand
selection_recipe.expanded_field_policy: retain every fitted encoded column of a selected original field; SV payload remains one field

reduced_training_recipe.comparison: same saved observations and allocation; reduced minus full; no equivalence pass/fail
